svg.title: EU DPP Registry compared with DPP5.0 requirements
svg.desc: Spherity assessment of the EU DPP Registry based on the 30 October 2026 technical package: shared semantic infrastructure is strong; verifiable claims, access, open-world status, accountability and graph dependencies need additional components. Based on page 28 of the original 36-page visual paper; adapted by removing slide numbering and footer while preserving explanatory diagrams.
